2610.03827.title: The Score Is Not the Structure: Brain Alignment and Cross-Lingual Transfer
2610.03827.paper_summary: Similarity scores are often offered as evidence that a model shares structure with the brain or across languages. We ask what such a score reads when that structure is removed, or when the instrument measuring it does not work, in two settings. Across seventeen languages, a grammaticality probe transfers worse between more distant languages (r = -0.66). But the probe's own accuracy falls along the same axis and is at chance in four languages, four of the five most distant. Dropping them halves the explained variance, and because it also narrows the range of distances, the design cannot say how much of the gradient is the instrument. Counting the 272 language pairs as independent gives p = 0.0006 for a steering effect that is null when the seventeen languages are the unit (p = 0.155). In brain alignment, a training objective raises a language model's similarity to fMRI responses from 0.10 to 0.34 (reliability ceiling 0.54), yet targets with the brain correspondence destroyed still reach 0.31. A shuffled target scores about k/n against the real one, for rank k and n sentences, a baseline that can be computed before any model is trained. Both interventions work, yet we detect no distance-graded steering effect and no syntactic benefit from alignment. Before reading a correspondence score, measure how much of it survives without the correspondence.
2610.03827.paper_summary_zh: 相似度分數通常被用作證據，表明模型與大腦或不同語言之間共享結構。我們詢問在該結構被移除或測量該結構的工具無法運作時，這樣的分數會顯示什麼，在兩種情境中。在十七種語言中，語法性探測器在更遙遠的語言之間轉移效果較差（r = -0.66）。但探測器自身的準確性沿著相同的軸線下降，在四種語言中達到隨機水平，這四種語言是五種最遙遠的語言之一。去掉這些語言後，解釋的變異數減半，並且因為這也縮小了距離範圍，這個設計無法說明梯度中有多少是工具的影響。將272對語言視為獨立的，對於一個在十七種語言為單位的引導效應，得到了p = 0.0006（當十七種語言為單位時，p = 0.155則為零）。在大腦對齊中，訓練目標將語言模型與fMRI反應的相似度從0.10提高到0.34（可靠性上限0.54），然而當大腦對應被破壞的目標仍然達到0.31。一個隨機排列的目標對真實目標的得分約為k/n，對於排名k和n句子，這是一個可以在任何模型訓練之前計算的基準。兩種干預都有效，但我們未檢測到距離分級的引導效應，也未從對齊中獲得任何句法好處。在閱讀對應分數之前，測量在沒有對應的情況下有多少分數能夠存活。
2610.03827.author: Saman Rahbar et.al.
